name: Echo Call & Response
desc: Self-echoing call-response lead: a short A-minor phrase speaks in the first half-cycle, then the dotted-eighth delay lattice (${fb} feedback, .375s at cps .5) answers through the deliberate silence. The gaps ARE the arrangement.

code.full: note("<[a4 c5 e5 a5] ~ [g4 b4 d5 ~] ~ [e5 c5 a4 ~] ~ [b4 d5 e5 g5] ~>").fast(2).add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.004).decay(.18).sustain(.12).release(.06).lpf(sine.range(1800,3200).slow(16)).lpq(2).shape(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(2)).delay(.8).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(${fb}).room(.25).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(8)).every(8, x=>x.add(note(12))).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[a4 c5 e5 a5] [~ ~ e5 ~] [g4 b4 d5 g5] ~ [e5 c5 a4 e5] [~ c5 ~ ~] [b4 d5 e5 g5] ~>").fast(2).add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.003).decay(.15).sustain(.12).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(2200,4200).slow(12)).lpq(2).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.72,${gain}).fast(4)).delay(.75).delaytime("<.375 .25>").delayfeedback(${fb}).room(.2).pan(sine.range(.32,.68).slow(6)).every(4, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
